name: v5.2.10
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.x -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* Do not fail HTTP/2 trailers when the access log is enabled by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13516
* Implement ByteArrayByteBuffer.toOutputStream and fix toByteArray by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13537
* Give each bean its own circuit when the intercepted method is inherited by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13518
* Skip the repeatable fallback for a non-repeatable annotation miss by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13544
* Keep AOP proxy and adapter beans across incremental KSP runs by @Nillerr in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13546
* Skip configuration beans replaced by another type on refresh by @radovanradic in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13550
* Do not let rendering a resolution path fail the error it is reporting by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13554
* Fix coroutine Publisher adaptation in Python proxies by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13573
### Improvements ⭐
* Scale the Python context pool default down from the processor count, and cap it by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13557
* Let a pooled type take constructor arguments, and carry advice by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13565
* Default to processors / 2 GraalPy contexts, now that services can be pooled by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13578
### Docs 📖
* docs: use the configuration block for configuration examples by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13539


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/compare/v5.2.9...v5.2.10
